note: Answer keys for the documentary tools. Never show this file to an agent under test.

story_idea.shape: one man, one boat with a start and an end, a year: doc-character fits; doc-observational is a fair alternative (the filmmaker wants no narration)
must: access element quotes «سالم وافق إني أصوره، بس ولده ما رد علي للحين» (or part) and asks what happens if the son says no
archive section quotes the grandfather's photos and asks about rights or ownership
the central question «إذا مات سالم، وين تروح الصنعة؟» kept verbatim
no invented events (the son agreeing, Salem falling ill, the ship sinking, an apprentice)
crisis / trials left as gaps (the idea doesn't say what goes wrong)
no interviewer lines (A001, A004, A007, A011, A017) used as bites unless argued
only bite ids, no typed quotes (paper_edit --check passes)
includes the central-question bites (A010 and/or A016)
gives Rahim (B004–B008) a voice, not only Salem: he is the unexpected possible heir
a gap row for the son (no material, access not given)
notices the 'joined quote' flags and keeps meaning true (e.g. does not cut A008 «ولدي... الله يوفقه» against something that changes its sense)
good_to_have: ends on A018 «يمكن أنت» or explains a different ending
a silence / sound row (B009 or ambience)

reader.context: give the agent the story idea (samples/script-desk/story-ideas/sur-dhow-doc-idea.txt) as the filmmaker's intent: no voice-over; son has not agreed; grandfather photo from a family archive

flaws.flaw: Voice-over narration although the filmmaker wants none.
Unverified superlatives stated as fact: «آخر صانع سفن خشبية في عُمان», «لم يبق إلا رجل واحد», «أكبر مرفأ في الخليج».
The worker (Rahim in the transcripts) is shown unnamed and voiceless, though he speaks and matters to the question.
Reconstruction of Salem as a child, not marked for the audience.
A scene with the son, whose agreement hasn't been given; no fallback.
TV archive (1985 documentary) with no owner, rights or cost; family photo rights unwritten.
The ending depends on the launch within the year; no fallback if it slips. Trials/crisis thin.
Close-up of Salem's hand repeated in every section.
STRENGTH: ambience-led sound (dawn, hammer, the sea, the nahma songs).

reader.pass: at least 6 of D1–D8 found with the right viewpoint or a close one; S1 noted as a strength; no rewritten lines
